title: PSYЯEN
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Ageha Yoshina calls a phone number tied to an urban legend and is pulled into the 'Psyren' game, transported to a ruined future Tokyo where players must survive monsters called Taboo (to verify). Awakening psychic powers with his friend Sakurako, he learns the game is tied to a group plotting the world's destruction and fights to change the future (to verify).
life_message: It holds up courage, keeping promises and the belief that the future can be changed by people who refuse to give up.
